name: MCAET College Website — Official & Live 🌐
desc: Built and deployed the official website of Mahamaya College of Agricultural Engineering & Technology (MCAET) — a government B.Tech, M.Tech & Ph.D engineering college under ANDUAT, Ayodhya, UP. The site is actively used by the college for all official communication. Features: responsive multi-page Next.js architecture, department pages (7 departments), faculty & administration directory, admissions info, placement section, media & events gallery, real-time notice board with scrolling ticker, academic calendar integration, government site carousel, YouTube college tour embed, weather & date widget, and an AI-powered Chatbot (🤖) integrated with Google Gemini API for answering student queries about courses, admissions, departments & campus — fully live and serving students, faculty, and the institution 24/7.

name: MCAET ExamHub — Online Exam Portal 🎓 LIVE
desc: Designed and developed the official Online Examination & Academic Evaluation Portal for MCAET — currently live and actively used by B.Tech, M.Tech, and Ph.D students for their online quizzes, mid-term, and end-term exams. Built with Next.js (React), Tailwind CSS, and secure backend. Features: separate secure logins for Students, Professors, and Administrative Officers; timed Computer-Based Tests (CBT) with question navigation; auto-scoring & instant results; professor dashboard for exam creation and question management; official Notice Board with live updates; 8 academic department pages (AE, CSE, FMPE, PEE, SWCE, IDE, REE, BEAS); FAQ, helpdesk & privacy policy pages; dark/light mode; AICTE & ICAR approved institution branding; IST timezone-enforced exam scheduling; and IT Act 2000 compliance security. Deployed on Vercel — HTTPS secured, SEO optimised, Google verified.
